heading: LFAC.1.3.3 — per-schema or per-emit TTL
text:
### LFAC.1.3.3 — per-schema or per-emit TTL [LDTL.5.1]

Overlays [LFAC.1.3.3] (ttl facts expire via per-schema or per-emit TTL).

In the default (without `dynamic_ttl`), [LFAC.1.3.3] is restricted:
the "per-emit TTL" path is not available.  Expiry is always per-schema.
[LFAC.1.3.3]'s mention of per-emit TTL is the full spec; it becomes
accessible only when `dynamic_ttl` is declared.
